rationale: The agent performed order-changing writes (item returns and an order cancellation) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy. Critically, it canceled the entire pending order #W2575533 even though the user only wanted to cancel the hose and explicitly said to forget it if single-item cancellation wasn’t possible—this directly contradicts the user’s instruction. Additionally, the refund amounts were asserted without visible tool outputs supporting them, and the final message suggests the entire order was canceled rather than just the hose. While the agent did appear to locate the user account and retrieve order details, the lack of confirmation and the incorrect cancellation decision mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
